narrative.intro: Consolidated Nuclear Security has $3.3B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Consolidated Nuclear Security received 1 award so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $3.3B. Consolidated Nuclear Security’s obligations are up 31.2% year over year. Consolidated Nuclear Security’s recent fiscal history shows obligations of $2.6B in FY21, $3.8B in FY22, $3.3B in FY23, $3.6B in FY24, and $2.5B in FY25. Consolidated Nuclear Security’s current-year totals are partial and cover the fiscal year to date; the figures presented are contract obligations except where tables note award-value totals. Consolidated Nuclear Security’s FY2026 position reflects a rebound from FY25 and parity with FY23 on an obligations basis. Consolidated Nuclear Security’s single large award this year drives the average award size figure, and the year-over-year change captures how obligations moved relative to the prior fiscal period. Stakeholders focused on federal nuclear and national security contracting should track award pipelines and upcoming solicitations for changes in obligation patterns.
